entities.summary: Dominique-Marie Varlet was a French prelate and missionary of the Catholic Church who served as vicar general of the Diocese of Quebec. Later, as the Latin Catholic Bishop of Babylon, he was involved in a schism within the Catholic Church by consecrating four men successively as Archbishop of Utrecht.
